summary: Mouse PK-PD relationships predict early bactericidal response for ten drugs, evaluated against fourteen clinical studies. Clinical PK, baseline bacterial burden and binding contribute to the predictions; scaling is used when human PK is unavailable.
validation: Useful for endpoint windows, exposure-response linkage and clinical comparison. It does not validate unknown human PK or prove transferability to PMB infection models.
data_availability: Open supplementary methods/figures; complete raw datasets and executable code not verified.
code_availability: Executable estimation code not verified; an accessible paper is not an executable model.
